Class RequestBody

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request.RequestBody
public final class RequestBody extends Object
The single request-body representation carried by an EquinixRequest. An immutable carrier in one of three shapes:
  • json(Object) — a Java payload object serialized to JSON;
  • form(Map) — application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields;
  • bytes(byte[], String) — a pre-encoded raw body (e.g. a hand-built multipart/form-data payload).

The wire entity is built from this carrier by RequestFactory at dispatch time — once per attempt — so a JSON payload that is mutated between dispatches (the POST-search paging pipeline advances the body's pagination offset) is re-serialized automatically. No transport (Apache HttpClient) type appears in this class's API.

ianjones
